description:
The TailwindTraders project has undergone a reorganization, splitting into three teams: Frontend, Backend, and Infrastructure. Currently, all work items are unstructured in the root area.

Your task:
1. Navigate to Project Settings > Boards > Team Configuration > Areas.
2. Create three new child Area Paths under 'TailwindTraders':
   - TailwindTraders\Backend
   - TailwindTraders\Frontend
   - TailwindTraders\Infrastructure

3. Return to the Backlog or Work Items view and reassign the existing 8 work items to their new areas based on this mapping:

   | Work Item Title | Target Area |
   |---|---|
   | Implement product search API endpoint | Backend |
   | Design REST API rate limiter middleware | Backend |
   | Fix product price rounding error | Backend |
   | Redesign shopping cart UI | Frontend |
   | Fix CSS grid layout on product listing page | Frontend |
   | Optimize dashboard lazy loading | Frontend |
   | Configure CI/CD pipeline alerts | Infrastructure |
   | Set up automated database backup schedule | Infrastructure |

4. Ensure no work items remain in the root 'TailwindTraders' area path.
